lessons: Validate complete syntax left to right before processing values; report the earliest byte that makes the input invalid, and defer later errors until earlier components pass.
Preserve source positions and requested identities through parsing and traversal; report the exact failing component and mutate the resolved target while retaining aliases.
Model state transitions and mutations explicitly; verify eligibility, ordering, tie-breaks, and every success, error, and early-return path.
Preserve pending work across incremental boundaries; advance past a timestamp only after handling every event due there, and exclude work predating insertion.
Derive complete existence checks from ordered-domain boundaries and adjacency rules instead of sampling representative candidates.
Translate output and sizing requirements literally; verify generated formats and formulas against the specified coordinate system, including fixed padding.
Track maximal removable runs across adjacent whitespace and nested constructs, preserving original boundaries until validation.
Validate untrusted sizes before allocation; use fallible, bounded capacity requests when inputs control memory use.

lessons: Check intermediate arithmetic across the full input range; use wider or overflow-safe comparisons when products can exceed the destination type.
Apply every specified validation rule to each relevant operation, preserving required error precedence before lookup or mutation.
Track cumulative resource consumption explicitly across state transitions; do not infer historical totals from entries removed during transitions.
Continue same-tick state processing after immediate completion until no event or dispatch remains enabled.
Compare a square-root radicand against the exact squared midpoint between neighboring integers, handling ties explicitly.
Track parser state explicitly, validate complete delimited structures and boundaries, and finalize each accepted construct immediately.
Preserve input context through shared parsing helpers so every failure path reports the required error classification.
Use valid character boundaries for UTF-8 slicing, and carry exact delimiter positions forward when reporting offsets after splitting.

lessons: Validate complete syntax and grammar before parsing values or applying semantic checks, so malformed input takes precedence according to specified error positions.
Derive bounds and explicit structure before applying transformations or expansion; distinguish source coordinates, field counts, and empty values from rendered text.
Check arithmetic and allocation boundaries before mutation or allocation; use checked operations and preserve atomicity when limits are exceeded.
Recompute derived data from the final converged state instead of retaining intermediate results.
Apply validation and traversal rules uniformly to initial and later inputs, including bytes inside quoted or escaped regions.
Track recursive work with explicit completion state, and unwind each resource only after its own work finishes.
Ensure each underlying item contributes exactly once to aggregates, and emit propagated events at the specified granularity.
Translate policies and ordering requirements into explicit predicates; account for all valid interval witnesses and prevent counter overflow from violating guarantees.
